summary: The root قنو (qnw) primarily means to keep to or preserve something, especially one's sense of shame or modesty.
lane: 1 قَنِىَ الحَيَآءَ ذ He kept to the sense of shame, or modesty; (S, K;) he preserved it: and i. q. اِسْتَحْيَى : and he kept to [or preserved ] his sense of shame, or modesty. (TA.) -b2- قَنَا غَنَمًا , and , He took for himself, got, or acquired, sheep, or goats [ for a permanent possession ], not for sale. (JK.) -b3- قَنَا , aor. يَقْنُو , inf. n. قُنُوٌّ ; a dial. var. of قَنَأَ , q. v. (TA.)

headwords.gloss: He gained, acquired; got, for himself; took for himself

parts.t: as a permanent stock, for propagation,
to be in his possession, not to depart from his hand:

headwords.def: اقْتَنَى He gained, acquired, or got, for himself, (S, K,) or took for himself, (Mgh,) property, or camels, &c., (S, Mgh,) as a permanent stock, for propagation, (Mgh,) not for merchandise: (S, Mgh:) he made it to be in his possession, not to depart from his hand: (TA:) he acquired it for himself permanently, or for a permanence. See 1.

parts.t: a name given in Egypt to

headwords.def: قَنًا of the nose: see شَمَمٌ . قنا وُشَّق a name given in Egypt to وُشَّق ; also called أُشَّق and أُشَّج . (TA in art. اشق .)

headwords.gloss: A spear-shaft; a spear; that is hollow, like a cane

parts.t: that is hollow, like a cane;
a spear with a head affixed to it.

headwords.def: قَنَاةٌ A spear-shaft; (Mgh;) a spear (T, S. K) that is hollow, like a cane; (Az, in TA;) a spear with a head affixed to it. (Msb.) Hence, A subterranean channel, or conduit, for water. (Mgh.) [And A pipe. ] قَنَاةُ الكُوزِ The بُلْبُل [or spout ] of the كوز [or mug ], that pours forth the water. (M, K, in art. بل .) قَنَاةٌ , said to signify بَقَرَةٌ وَحْشِيَّةٌ : see فَنَاةٌ .

headwords.gloss: taken for oneself, gotten; acquired; for a permanent possession
headwords.def: قِنْيَةٌ and Sheep, or goats, taken for oneself, gotten, or acquired, [ for a permanent possession, ] not for sale. (JK.)
أَقْنَى in the prov., خَلَاؤُكَ أَقْنَى لِحَيائِكَ i. q. أَلْزَمُ [as meaning Most preservative: see that prov. in art. خلو , and see قَنِىَ الحَيَآءَ , above]. (S in art. خلو , and Meyd.)

headwords.gloss: weaving with one thread white and one thread black

parts.t: weaving with one thread white and one thread black.

headwords.def: مُقَانَاةٌ The weaving with one thread white and one thread black. (T, voce نِيرٌ .)
